chunks.content: Annual leave. Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Requests longer than three days need manager approval at least ten business days in advance.
Remote work. Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Everyone must be available during the core collaboration hours of 10:00 to 15:00 local time.
Business expenses. An itemized receipt is required for every expense over 25 dollars. Reimbursement claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days of purchase.
Account security. Multi-factor authentication, also called MFA, is mandatory for email, source control, payroll, and VPN access. Password sharing is prohibited.
Critical severity incidents. The on-call engineer must acknowledge a severity-one incident within 15 minutes. Customer status updates are required every 30 minutes until mitigation.
Postmortems. A blameless postmortem for every severity-one or severity-two incident must be completed within five business days after resolution.
Incident evidence retention. Security audit logs are retained for 90 days. Evidence attached to a confirmed security incident is retained for one year.
Incident escalation. The primary on-call engineer pages the secondary after ten minutes without acknowledgement, then assigns an incident commander for cross-team coordination.
Record retention. Customer financial and tax records are retained for seven years to satisfy legal obligations. Inactive customer profile data is removed after two years.
Deletion requests. A verified customer deletion request must be completed within 30 calendar days unless a legal hold requires specific records to remain.
Data classification. Information is labeled public, internal, confidential, or restricted. Payment credentials and authentication secrets are always restricted.
Governance backups. Compliance records are backed up daily, encrypted at rest, and retained in backup storage for 35 days.
Maintenance window. Planned production maintenance occurs on Tuesdays from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. Customers receive at least 48 hours notice.
Service backups. Production databases are backed up every six hours. Restore drills run monthly, and recovery copies remain available for 14 days.
Availability objectives. The standard service target is 99.9 percent monthly uptime. Enterprise service target is 99.95 percent monthly uptime.
Support escalation. A critical support ticket receives an initial response within 30 minutes and escalates to the duty manager if unresolved after one hour.
Air travel. Economy class is required for flights under six hours. Business class for longer flights requires vice-president approval.
Hotels. The standard hotel limit is 220 dollars per night before tax. Conference hotels above the limit require director approval.
Meals. Travelers may claim up to 75 dollars per day for meals, excluding alcohol and personal entertainment.
Travel receipts. Itemized receipts are mandatory for travel purchases over 25 dollars. Travel claims must be filed within ten business days after returning.
